body: Phase H1 of docs/headless-cli-plan.md. Move the My work lists into a core file with no runtime imports, shared by the board, a new `sati inbox` command and a read-only MCP `inbox` tool.

completion.releaseNote: `sati inbox` and the MCP tool `inbox` show what waits for you: questions, mentions, approvals, assigned and due tasks.
completion.summary: H1 of docs/headless-cli-plan.md. The rule behind the board's My work page now lives in packages/core/src/domain/inbox.ts (no runtime imports; the board reads it by relative path, bundle unchanged at 424 KB). New inbox service with a Zod output schema, `sati inbox` (sections for a person, one prefixed line per item in a pipe, --json, --for) and a read-only MCP tool `inbox` (22 tools). The duplicate mention rule in the board is gone; comment.ts re-exports the core one. Gate: lint, typecheck, tests (245 pass, 3 skipped: 2 Windows-only, 1 in output.test.ts as before), 97 Playwright tests pass.

title: H1: inbox in the core, sati inbox, MCP inbox tool
